title: Sparkly avocado
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- Sparkles around the avocado -->
  <g fill="#FFF59D">
    <!-- Sparkle top-left -->
    <path d="M22 18 L24 24 L30 26 L24 28 L22 34 L20 28 L14 26 L20 24 Z"/>
    <!-- Sparkle top-right -->
    <path d="M78 15 L80 21 L86 23 L80 25 L78 31 L76 25 L70 23 L76 21 Z"/>
    <!-- Sparkle right -->
    <path d="M84 50 L85.5 55 L90 56.5 L85.5 58 L84 63 L82.5 58 L78 56.5 L82.5 55 Z"/>
    <!-- Sparkle bottom-left small -->
    <path d="M20 68 L21.5 72 L25.5 73.5 L21.5 75 L20 79 L18.5 75 L14.5 73.5 L18.5 72 Z"/>
    <!-- Sparkle bottom-right small -->
    <path d="M76 75 L77.5 79 L81.5 80.5 L77.5 82 L76 86 L74.5 82 L70.5 80.5 L74.5 79 Z"/>
    <!-- Tiny star top -->
    <path d="M50 8 L51 11 L54 12 L51 13 L50 16 L49 13 L46 12 L49 11 Z"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Avocado outer skin -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="56" rx="26" ry="34" fill="#4CAF50"/>
  <!-- Skin highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="56" rx="24" ry="32" fill="#66BB6A"/>

  <!-- Avocado flesh -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="20" ry="27" fill="#C5E1A5"/>
  <!-- Flesh inner lighter -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="17" ry="24" fill="#DCEDC8"/>

  <!-- Avocado pit (seed) -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="10" ry="11" fill="#8D6E63"/>
  <!-- Pit highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="47" cy="62" rx="4" ry="4" fill="#A1887F"/>

  <!-- Cute face on the avocado flesh area -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="46" rx="3" ry="3.5" fill="#33691E"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="46" rx="3" ry="3.5" fill="#33691E"/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="45" r="1.2" fill="#DCEDC8"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="45" r="1.2" fill="#DCEDC8"/>
  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx="37" cy="52" rx="3.5" ry="2" fill="#F48FB1"/>
  <ellipse cx="63" cy="52" rx="3.5" ry="2" fill="#F48FB1"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M45 53 Q50 58 55 53" stroke="#33691E" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
